description: This file defines the ACLRolesViewList class, which extends ViewList, and includes a preDisplay method that checks user permissions and configures the list view settings. It is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically related to listing ACL roles.

classes.name: ACLRolesViewList
classes.description: A view class responsible for listing ACL roles with permission checks in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks user permissions and sets up the ListViewSmarty object for displaying the list of roles.
